questions.text: Does the new text describe an event or condition that has already occurred, where the old text described it as a possibility?
Does the new text name a specific geography, government, regulation, or counterparty not named in the old text?
Does the new text state or quantify a financial or operational impact not stated in the old text?
Does the change narrow or remove a previously disclosed exposure?

weights.description: The risk has no counterpart in the prior filing.
weights.label: New risk factor

weights.description: The prior filing's risk has no counterpart in the new filing.
weights.label: Risk factor removed

weights.description: Substantial wording changes in both directions.
weights.label: Risk was materially reworded

weights.description: Net addition of at least 15% of the text.
weights.label: Risk was expanded

weights.description: Net removal of at least 15% of the text.
weights.label: Risk was reduced

weights.description: A 'may/could/might' statement became 'has/have/resulted in' wording for the same content (first hit; +5 per additional hit, max 30).
weights.label: Hedged language became actual language

weights.description: Per newly named entity (spaCy NER), max 12.
weights.label: New named geography, organization, or law

weights.description: Per new dollar amount, percentage, or counted unit, max 15.
weights.label: New quantified amount or percentage

weights.description: Added text is at least 40% of the new block (not for 'new' blocks).
weights.label: Large share of new text

weights.description: Pair similarity below the reworded threshold.
weights.label: Meaning shifted noticeably
AI rubric: a possibility became an occurred event
AI rubric: new specific geography, government, regulation, or counterparty
AI rubric: newly stated or quantified impact
AI rubric: a previously disclosed exposure was narrowed or removed
